$comment: Known device capabilities that the device itself does not report over USB. Keys are lower-case hex vid:pid. usb4_id is the optional USB4 router vid:pid the same product presents when it tunnels PCIe. max_link is the fastest link the device can use anywhere; claimed_*_mbps are the manufacturer's headline numbers. Community-contributable.

1b1c:1a20.name: Corsair EX400U
1b1c:1a20.notes: USB4 NVMe SSD. On a 10 Gbps port it enumerates as USB 3.2 Gen 2 storage; on a USB4 / Thunderbolt port it tunnels PCIe and appears as an NVMe disk behind a USB4 router.

17e9:ff1a.name: Elgato Prompter
17e9:ff1a.notes: DisplayLink-based USB display. Produces steady bulk traffic while showing content, which shares the dock uplink.
